title: feat(service-datasource): the Studio connection form offers Oracle and SQL Server, federation only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97vPuFfB4ofnDGXxVYd3NjZ)_

Fixes #31389

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio「新建数据源」的驱动下拉新增 Oracle Database 和 SQL Server 两项；选中它们时，「结构模式」只提供「外部」和「仅校验」，不再提供「托管」，并在下方用一句话说明原因。
- **为什么改**：这两个驱动此前已经落地（只做联邦），但只能在代码里声明，管理员无法在界面上连接已有的老库（ERP、财务库）。
- **风险与回滚**：驱动目录接口的每个条目可能多出一个新字段 `federationOnly: true`（只出现在这两个驱动上），属于加宽；其它驱动条目字节不变。回滚即整体 revert。
- **先看**：① `packages/services/service-datasource/src/driver-catalog.ts`（新条目与 `federationOnly` 投影）② `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` 的 `schemaModesFor` 与切换驱动时的模式回落 ③ `driver-catalog-translations.ts` 十种语言的新词。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/driver-catalog.test.ts`，预期 37 条全过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/service-datasource`**: `DRIVER_CATALOG` (served by `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers`) gains `oracle` (label `Oracle Database`) and `mssql` (label `SQL Server`). Their `configSchema` is the spec projection (`getDriverConfigJsonSchemaById`), like every other entry; nothing in the catalog loads `oracledb` or `tedious`. Each carries a new key, `federationOnly: true`, projected from the spec's `FEDERATION_ONLY_DRIVER_IDS` and not restated; it is absent (never `false`) on every other entry, the way the spec column it projects is. The old module note saying `mssql` is left out is replaced by one saying why the federation-only drivers are offered.
- **Translations**: `driver-catalog-translations.ts` carries both drivers' description and every connection field's title and description in all ten non-English languages on the platform locale table (the same set every other entry carries). Product names (`Oracle Database`, `SQL Server`) are not translated, like `PostgreSQL`.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: the New datasource dialog reads the catalog's `federationOnly`. For a marked driver the Schema mode select offers External and Validate only (the two federation modes the spec accepts), never Managed, and one sentence under it says why. A Managed choice made on another driver moves to External when a marked driver is chosen. No driver id is written in `ui/`.
- **Missing `tedious` remedy** (seat 1 patch round): `tedious`, the package knex's `client: 'mssql'` requires, joins `OPTIONAL_DRIVER_CLIENT_PACKAGES` in `connect-failure-remedy.ts`, so a SQL Server datasource without it is refused with the install of `tedious` as its remedy, like `pg`, `mysql2`, `better-sqlite3` and `oracledb`; before, it was told to run `pnpm install && pnpm build`. This PR is what puts SQL Server in the form, so it is what makes that answer reachable.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: one new studio key, `engine.datasource.schemaModeFederationOnly` (en, zh).
- Changeset: `.changeset/31389-federation-only-driver-catalog.md` (patch on all three packages).

## Tests

- `driver-catalog.test.ts`: the id list now ends `oracle`, `mssql` (forced edit: the published id list grew); `PRODUCT_NAME_LABELS` gains both (forced edit: their labels are product names); the icon equality across languages now also compares `federationOnly` (forced edit). New: the mark is exactly `FEDERATION_ONLY_DRIVER_IDS` and absent on every other entry; the spec refuses either driver as `managed` and accepts it as `external` / `validate-only`; Simplified Chinese words for both and the mark kept through localisation. The coverage battery walks every language over both new entries.
- `missing-driver-client-boot-refusal.test.ts`: a `tedious` arm beside the `oracledb` one (real factory, real `SqlDriver`, knex's genuine `Cannot find module 'tedious'`): the `mssql` default is refused, ending on `missingDriverClientRemedy('tedious')`, never the build sentence.
- `DatasourceResourcePage.newDatasourceModes-30327.test.tsx` (the dialog's existing schema-mode harness, new top-level `describe`; its served driver list gains the two catalog entries): (h) Oracle and SQL Server offer exactly External and Validate only, the reason sentence shows, Create sends `schemaMode: 'external'` with `external: {}`; (i) Managed chosen on PostgreSQL moves to External on choosing SQL Server; (j) CONTROL: PostgreSQL offers all three modes and no reason sentence; zh reads in Chinese.

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored; git diff HEAD empty after each)</summary>

All four through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob moved, restored to the HEAD blob). The suites import source directly, so no dist leg.

1. Catalog: `federationOnly` set on every entry (`false` on unmarked ones) → `marks exactly the spec's federation-only drivers, and no other entry` red (`memory: expected true to be false`), plus the zh mark test; 2 failed / 35 passed.
2. Form: `schemaModesFor` returns all three modes for a marked driver → (h) Oracle, (h) SQL Server (`expected [ …(3) ] to deeply equal [ …(2) ]`) and (i) red; 3 failed / 9 passed.
3. Form: reason sentence rendered for any driver → (j) CONTROL red (the reason paragraph was found where null was expected); 1 failed / 11 passed.
4. Remedy: `tedious` taken back out of `OPTIONAL_DRIVER_CLIENT_PACKAGES` → `tedious absent: the mssql default is refused, ending on the install of that client` red (`expected false to be true`); 1 failed / 6 passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② measured `yes (widening)`, not the claim's `no`**: the form needs the federation-only fact and the card says it must read it from the catalog, so the catalog answer gains a key. Measured on base `6b83ec2d` vs head through `driverCatalogFor(undefined | 'zh-CN')`: base serves 5 entries, each with keys `configSchema,description,icon,id,label`; head serves 7, the five unchanged and `oracle` / `mssql` with `configSchema,description,federationOnly,icon,id,label`.
- **New public key `federationOnly`**: spelled after the spec column it projects (`DriverVocabularyEntry.federationOnly`, `true` or absent). The seat rules the name.
- **Validate only stays offered**: the card says the form offers only `external`. The spec accepts both federation modes for these drivers (`federationOnly` doc: `schemaMode: 'external'` / `'validate-only'`), and the form offers Validate only for every driver, so only Managed is withheld. Hiding Validate only too would also leave an existing `validate-only` SQL Server row's edit dialog with a selected value no option names.
- **Stale QA checklist text**: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` lines 1341 and 1353 describe the catalog as `memory/sqlite/postgres/mysql/mongodb`; it now also lists `oracle` and `mssql`. Outside the claim's file surface, so not edited here.
- **Seat rulings**: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` as measured and the key name `federationOnly` stand; Validate only stays offered (the spec, not the card's wording, decides); the full app-shell suite is left to CI `Test UI`.

## Verification

At head `0f59ea948`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: 74 files, 1295 / 1295 passed; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: test 99 files, 1804 passed / 13 skipped; `type-check` exit 0. `@object-ui/app-shell`: `type-check` exit 0; `src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/` 9 files, 59 / 59 passed. The full app-shell suite (2218 files) is left to CI `Test UI` (declared narrowing).
- Lint: root eslint on `packages/services/service-datasource` exit 0; `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `lint` exit 0 (warnings only, none on changed lines).
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `0f59ea948` derived 68 families (the new one: `check:optional-error-sink`); all 68 ran with exit 0 on the first pass (`--ran`: 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). At `f6295c173` the 67 then derived were likewise all green.
- Dogfood battery (asked for by the dispatch), at `f6295c173`, before the remedy commit; not re-run on `0f59ea948`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, 443 files (440 passed, 3 skipped), 3674 tests (3633 passed, 41 skipped).

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (no `packages/spec` edit)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
